content.summary: Mobileye Global (NasdaqGS:MBLY) has introduced an AI architecture that sends non-safety work to the cloud while keeping safety-critical processing inside each vehicle. The company plans to use this system in partnership with Volkswagen to support a target of 100,000 robotaxis on the road by 2033.
